•

•
Compliance & Regulatory Program Delivery : Drive the strategy and execution for acquiring and maintaining critical certifications (such as FIPS, Common Criteria, and FedRAMP), expanding Everpure’s addressable market in public and private sectors.

•
Resilience & Vulnerability Governance : Oversee product threat-response protocols and vulnerability lifecycle management, prioritizing rapid patch deployment to safeguard the global FlashArray install base and protect customer uptime.

•
Executive & Commercial Alignment : Partner with executive leaders, Sales, and Marketing to articulate Everpure’s security value proposition, turning complex resilience architecture into enterprise revenue growth.

•
People Leadership & Organizational Impact : Proven ability to recruit, empower, and lead high-performing product management teams, with expertise in strategic resource allocation, team development, and operational planning.

•
Security & Systems Architecture Expertise : Deep technical command of enterprise security protocols, encryption standards, identity management, and distributed storage systems architecture.

description:
About the team

Hardware Procurement Operations enables OpenAI’s hardware and infrastructure businesses to execute supplier engagements and purchases at speed while maintaining financial discipline, clear ownership, and effective controls.

Our work spans procurement execution, process and systems enablement, and lifecycle governance-from initial requests and agreements through purchasing, payment, and closeout, with related asset and inventory governance. We build practical operating models, resolve cross-functional barriers, and improve the tools and processes that help teams scale.

About the role

You will own procurement execution for complex infrastructure deals, including land transactions, lease agreements, power purchase agreements, and fast-moving colocation and fiber engagements. Scope may expand to cloud service provider (CSP) engagements and sourcing activities as business needs evolve.

This senior individual contributor role combines hands-on lifecycle management with commercial judgment and building scalable operations. You will recognize gaps in proposed supplier engagements, work with business owners, sourcing, Legal, and Finance to improve them, and translate agreements into executable purchasing and payment plans. You will also build standard processes and automation that help teams move faster while reducing deal risk.

In this role, you will:

- Drive assigned engagements from intake and agreement execution through purchasing, ongoing obligations, amendments, renewals, final payments, and closeout.

- Assess commercial and operational readiness, identify gaps in scope, deliverables, acceptance criteria, and payment terms, and drive resolution with the appropriate partners.

- Resolve commercial, financial, and operational dependencies, aligning owners on required reviews and approvals. Represent procurement operations in deal planning and senior stakeholder escalations, presenting clear recommendations on commercial readiness, risks, and execution tradeoffs while respecting each function’s decision authority.

- Maintain accurate obligation and purchasing records; coordinate payment readiness, acceptance evidence, invoice exceptions, and reconciliation with business owners, Treasury, Accounting, and Accounts Payable.

- Establish procurement operating standards and influence business, sourcing, Legal, and Finance partners to adopt practices that improve supplier engagement quality, accelerate execution, and reduce risk. Build the processes, templates, playbooks, and upstream review cycles that make those standards actionable.

- Design, implement, and manage workflow automation and AI agents, partnering with technical teams where needed; own testing, adoption, monitoring, exception handling, and appropriate human review and approval controls.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have independently managed complex procurement engagements through post-signature execution and closeout, with experience in at least one infrastructure category such as land, leases, power, colocation, or fiber.

- Can distinguish well-structured supplier engagements from those that create avoidable ambiguity or exposure, recommend practical improvements, and recognize when Legal or Accounting judgment is required.

- Understand contractual obligations, payment structures, and procurement controls, and can translate them into clear execution plans.

- Can independently prioritize time-sensitive engagements, navigate ambiguity, and resolve cross-functional dependencies, seeking guidance on complex or consequential decisions. Communicate risks and tradeoffs clearly and influence senior stakeholders without formal authority.

- Have built repeatable processes in an ambiguous environment and use procurement, contract management, and ERP systems and operational data to improve execution.

- Have delivered workflow automation or AI agent solutions with measurable results and can manage their reliability, exceptions, and controls.

title: Aerodynamics Expert
description:
Aerodynamics Expert
Pay: $80-$120/hour
Location: Global, fully remote
Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)
Schedule: Flexible-you can choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired
We are looking for a highly skilled Aerodynamics Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving computational fluid dynamics, aerodynamic analysis, engineering simulation, and Python.
The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks that can be completed through programmatic, command-line-based workflows. A representative task may require analyzing an airfoil, preparing a computational domain and mesh, defining appropriate boundary conditions, running a CFD simulation, calculating lift and drag, and determining whether the resulting flow field is numerically and physically valid.
What You’ll Work On

• Solve and validate aerodynamic and fluid-dynamics problems.

• Translate physical requirements into computational models and solver-ready cases.

• Create or modify geometries, computational domains, and meshes.

• Define appropriate initial conditions, boundary conditions, fluid properties, and solver settings.

• Run CFD and aerodynamic-analysis workflows using command-line-accessible tools.

• Use Python to automate preprocessing, simulation execution, parameter sweeps, postprocessing, and validation.

Required Qualifications

• BSc, MSc or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with an aerodynamics, fluid dynamics, or thermofluids specialization; or

• A BS in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering plus at least 1-2 years of aero-specific professional or research experience.

• Strong understanding of fluid mechanics and applied aerodynamics.

• Experience formulating and executing CFD or aerodynamic analyses.

• Practical proficiency with Python or other coding languages .

Relevant tools may include Python, OpenFOAM, SU2, Gmsh, FEniCSx, Elmer, CalculiX, SciPy , or similar programmatic engineering software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.
Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter , solver APIs, mesh-processing libraries, or domain-specific scientific packages. No single library is mandatory.
Process

• Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.

• Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.

• Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure
Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.
Minimum submission requirements apply.
Start Timeline & Availability

• We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24-48 hours of completing onboarding.
